document.name: Imagine Swimming Crown Heights Armory
document.shortDescription: Seven-day swim lessons at the Crown Heights Armory for babies, kids, and teens starting at 18 months.
document.longDescription:
Imagine Swimming's official Crown Heights Armory page says the Brooklyn pool serves families in Crown Heights and surrounding neighborhoods and offers swim lessons for babies, children, and adults. The official page states that this location is suited for ages 18 months and older.

The official Weekly Lessons page says lessons at the Crown Heights Armory are offered 7 days a week from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The official Crown Heights Armory page lists the facility at 1561 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11225 and describes the location as a Crown Heights site with a supportive, safety-first swim instruction model.

Imagine Swimming's official locations page publishes the general business contact details as phone 212-253-9650 and email info@imagineswimming.com.

Sources: https://www.imagineswimming.com/locations/crown-heights-armory https://www.imagineswimming.com/our-offerings/weekly-lessons https://www.imagineswimming.com/locations.html https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3398a9_daf07cb1ca864e14952e3b831d25c278~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_192,h_192,lg_1,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/3398a9_daf07cb1ca864e14952e3b831d25c278~mv2.png
